659:t_221:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「This one... Does he harbor the sun within his body?!」

659:t_221:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「I'll take you on, ravenous destroyers! If you don't fear the radiance of this sun, come at me!」

659:t_222:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You bastard! If you swallow us, you'll get a lot more than a stomachache!」

659:t_222:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You needn't worry, boy.」

659:t_222:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You too will gain eternity by becoming one with us.」

659:t_222:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「There's no way I'm turning into something that creepy!」

659:t_222:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Get ready, you cosmic pests! $$トライダー$$, $c and I will exterminate you here!」

659:t_223:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「If you can think for yourselves and still attack people, you're no different from criminals!」

659:t_223:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You would impose Earthlings' rules... their natural order, here?」

659:t_223:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You're small-minded... Far too small-minded, boy!」

659:t_223:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Justice strikes down evil! That rule holds on Earth and throughout the universe!」

659:t_223:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Don't hold back, $$鉄人$$! Give them everything you've got!」

659:t_224:0.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You've come, wielder of the power of light!」

659:t_224:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We will claim your soul and your steel body, everything! With the power of the Great Void!」

659:t_224:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「To hell with the power of the Great Void! We're alive... We exist!」

659:t_224:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Let's go, $$マジンガー$$! We'll use our power to tear through their endless darkness!」

659:t_225:0.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Come, warrior of $$ゲッター線$$!」

659:t_225:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We'll settle here which of us was chosen by $$ゲッター線$$!」

659:t_225:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That's just what I want, $$インベーダー#pilot$$!」

659:t_225:3.en:
$$隼人$$
「Come to think of it, we've been dealing with these creatures for a long time.」

659:t_225:4.en:
$$弁慶$$
「And with you guys too, while we're at it.」

659:t_225:5.en:
$$隼人$$
「Too bad. It looks like the Getter Team won't be disbanding even after we beat them.」

659:t_225:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Our fight still goes on! We can't keep wasting our time on creatures like these forever!」

659:t_225:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's go, $$ゲッター$$! We'll blow their Great Void away!」

659:t_226:0.en:
$$號$$
(The Great Void... Eternal darkness... It is the greatest, most powerful enemy of all living things...)

659:t_226:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You emissary of $$ゲッター線$$! Are you helpless before our immense power?!」

659:t_226:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「If you've learned your place, submit quietly and let us absorb you!」

659:t_226:3.en:
$$凱$$
「Don't just stand there, $$號$$! The giant $$インベーダー#robot$$ is right in front of us!」

659:t_226:4.en:
$$渓$$
「I'm counting on you, $$號$$. We've entrusted you with both our lives and $$ゲッター$$'s power!」

659:t_226:6.en:
$$號$$
「Let's do this, $$ゲッター$$! We'll overcome the Great Void to open a path to the future!」

659:t_227:0.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You possess the factors of both light and darkness! Your name is $$マーズ$$!」

659:t_227:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「One side of your existence is of the same nature as our Great Void! In other words, you are one of us!」

659:t_227:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「This malice isn't just theirs! This entire space is trying to devour every living thing!」

659:t_227:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「I won't lose! ...As long as I'm alive, I'll keep fighting for the promise I made to my brother!」

659:t_228:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「The day has finally come, $$インベーダー#pilot$$! Today, I'll settle things with you once and for all!」

659:t_228:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Spiral Man! If you too would challenge the $$御使い$$s, offer your power to us!」

659:t_228:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Then we will have a chance to defeat them! That is our hope!」

659:t_228:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「I refuse! My friends and I will fight the $$御使い$$s without borrowing any of your power!」

659:t_228:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「Here I go! My drill will punch straight through your nonsensical logic and your ambitions together!」

659:t_229:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$バアル$$...! Humanity's natural enemy...!」

659:t_229:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Can you win? Our power is beyond comparison with those embodiments of endless destruction you fought!」

659:t_229:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We are the emissaries of the Great Void... of the force that seeks to vanish! We will remake this universe!」

659:t_229:3.en:
$$カズミ$$
「If they've called themselves $$バアル$$, you needn't hold back, $$ノリコ$$!」

659:t_229:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ガンバスター$$'s mission is to protect humanity! We'll take you on!」

659:t_230:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You're not $$バアル$$, but you really were $$バアル$$ after all!」

659:t_230:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「You're not $$バアル$$, but you really were $$バアル$$ after all!」

659:t_230:2.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「You're not $$バアル$$, but you really were $$バアル$$ after all!」

659:t_230:3.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「At this point, the name $$バアル$$ means nothing to us!」

659:t_230:4.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We will devour everything! You, the $$御使い$$s, and this universe!」

659:t_230:5.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I won't hold back against an enemy like that! Because...!」

659:t_230:6.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「I won't hold back against an enemy like that! Because...!」

659:t_230:7.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「I won't hold back against an enemy like that! Because...!」

659:t_230:8.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ is a $$バスターマシン$$! She's a power meant to protect humanity from $$バアル$$!」

659:t_230:9.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$ノノ$$ is a $$バスターマシン$$! She's a power meant to protect humanity from $$バアル$$!」

659:t_230:10.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「$$ノノ$$ is a $$バスターマシン$$! She's a power meant to protect humanity from $$バアル$$!」

659:t_231:0.en:
$$葵$$
「Thinking this is the last time I'll have to see your gross faces really gets me fired up!」

659:t_231:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Ugly?! You're calling our forms ugly?!」

659:t_231:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Impossible! We are the most powerful species in the universe! Power should be beauty itself!」

659:t_231:3.en:
$$葵$$
「We really are way too different, from our tastes to everything else!」

659:t_231:4.en:
$$葵$$
「I'll end this here, $$インベーダー#pilot$$! Let's do this!!」

659:t_232:0.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You presumptuous salaryman! Your luck ran out when you blundered into the galaxy!」

659:t_232:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「But even that recklessness is power! Become one with us!」

659:t_232:2.en:
$$赤木$$
「I'm not interested in your mergers and acquisitions! We're humans who cry, laugh, and live as hard as we can!」

659:t_232:3.en:
$$赤木$$
「You take lives with your self-serving logic, and we'll stop you here! That's our duty... our duty as humans!!」

659:t_233:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「What a shame. We can certainly communicate, but there's no talking sense with you.」

659:t_233:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「It cannot be helped. Earthlings could hardly understand our words.」

659:t_233:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「But there is no need to worry. Once you become one with us, there will be no problem.」

659:t_233:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I'm saying your selfish, coercive logic isn't worth debating.」

659:t_233:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So I'll do things your way! It will be rough, but consider it the consequence of your own actions!」

659:t_234:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
「We're alive...! Everyone wants to live!」

659:t_234:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
「If you're going to take that away...! Then I'll do what I have to, to protect everyone...!」

659:t_234:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「It is useless, boy. What can a single human do?」

659:t_234:3.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「But the artificial human you pilot is alluring. We very much want its power!」

659:t_234:4.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I won't... hand over the EVA! It's all I have left!」

659:t_235:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「To hell with your Great Void! We're alive, and we'll blow it away!」

659:t_235:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Your bravado, at least, is impressive, boy.」

659:t_235:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「But I can feel it... A small yet powerful force protecting this boy!」

659:t_235:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That's $$ティファ$$'s love! You wouldn't understand it!」
